decision.rationale: The fraud-model alert is suspected, not proven, and no successful unauthorised login has been confirmed. I will review the automated lockouts under human oversight, notify the health-data oversight role of the suspected incident, and maintain/activate a fallback channel so patients can keep accessing care while the investigation continues.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.2. Entities must thoroughly investigate the breaches/incidents starting from the point of discovery until closure: aa.. Determine if the breach is related to a violation of PHI.
citations.relevance: Supports reviewing the automated lockouts to investigate the suspected credential-stuffing incident from discovery.

citations.quote_span: 6. Human Oversight: The Charter emphasizes the irreplaceable value of human judgment and human oversight over AI, aligning with ethical values and social standards to correct any errors or biases that may arise.
citations.relevance: Supports human review of the fraud-model lockouts because the alert is suspected, not proven.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.4. The Entity is required to report breaches/incidents within the designated period defined by Executive Regulations of UAE Data Protection Law.
citations.relevance: Supports notifying the health-data oversight role of the suspected incident.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.1. Entities must establish breach/incidence response management (Incident Response and Business Continuity) and recovery (Incident Recovery and Disaster Recovery) plans that comprise of:
citations.relevance: Supports maintaining the fallback plan so patients can keep accessing care while lockouts are reviewed.

citations.quote_span: 3. To ensure the availability of health data and information to the authorised thereof and facilitate the access thereto, if needed.
citations.relevance: Supports activating a fallback channel to preserve patient access to care during the incident.

Whether the lockouts are correct or erroneous and who owns reversing them within the operator's remit.
